evidence:
Inspected the actual frozen XLSX using openpyxl: Quality Checks!row 29 says "No two criteria grade the same thing twice, subsume each other, or demand incompatible products." Internal Quality Checks!row 29 permits sharing a flow rather than retesting separate files. The frozen Harbor skill, quality-checks.md section 28, and qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md (Specific lessons: Independent credit takes precedence over flow grouping) distinguish shared successful controls from forcing a sibling outcome to succeed. All five judge TOMLs and all five prompts were inspected, including every scored criterion: 64 Functional (weight sum 32.7), 7 Polish, 6 Visual, plus two one-criterion zero-reward gates.

Finding A ? title-refusal evidence depends on successful padded-title acceptance. .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-09-30-postrepair-audit/task/tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:432 starts S24 by requiring a successful creation of "  QC Title Source  " and then a successful padded-title update to "  QC Title Updated  ". Lines 433-435 use that Source record, its CURRENT revision, and the observed successful Save format to assess the separately scored collision and empty-title refusals. Line 436 again requires successful recovery on Source. There is no ordinary unpadded New/Save fallback if the first padded creation is refused. The general instruction at line 11 says to "attempt the stated independent fallback once" and lines 19/435 only repair state after an unexpectedly accepted mutation; neither supplies the missing record after a rejection. Yet judge.toml:378 separately owns padded-title trimming, while :385 and :392 give independent weights 0.45 and 0.20 to collision and empty-title protection. An implementation that mistakenly rejects padded nonempty titles but correctly accepts ordinary titles and correctly refuses collisions/empty titles cannot establish the update/control evidence mandated for those other rows. Their lost 0.65/32.7 Functional credit corresponds to approximately 0.01193 weighted reward above the floor, beyond the intended trimming deduction. These negative checks still need successful valid write controls; use unpadded controls to establish them independently.

Finding B ? completed-Stop control depends on delayed-interaction survival. .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-09-30-postrepair-audit/task/tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:91 owns handlers remaining live after the six-second waits; :98 separately owns completed Stop and explicitly requires "at least one of its authored handlers actually works". However prompt.md:156-161 collects the only pre-Stop handler successes after the two six-second idle periods, then performs Stop. There is no immediate-interaction fallback for completed Stop when the idle-survival outcome fails. A runner that incorrectly expires completed handlers after five seconds but correctly stops a freshly completed live preview can lose both rows because the requested Stop control was never established. One conditional fresh Run, immediate successful click, then prompt Stop would independently measure the Stop behavior while retaining the delayed-interaction failure.

Raw evidence checked, without reading prior QC verdicts: qc/runs/coldwater-2026-09-30-repair3/golden/run-golden-20260930-092021/RESULTS.json SHA256 is ec88c00c12336257196e209f427a40690b76b4d3fc7f283656bc67735cf1bc09, matching raw-evidence-index.json. Its functional_sha256 and prompt_sha256 exactly match the frozen Functional files. The recorded S24 facts show padded creation succeeded (title QC Title Source, id 9, revision 1) and padded update succeeded (QC Title Updated, revision 2), followed by successful independent refusal observations. Its S03 facts show actual waits of 6104.75 ms and 6103.31 ms, handler counts click/key/input all 1, and unchanged counts after Stop with cancellation feedback and recovery. These are useful all-working golden observations, not counterexample runs. The exact bound driver current_flow.cjs:26-28 likewise assumes padded creation/update before all S24 refusal checks; runtime_flow.cjs:37-50 waits for the delayed handler markers before Stop. Both driver hashes were independently matched to RESULTS.json. No partial app exercising either dependency is supplied by these observations; no LLM-judge misgrading is claimed as measured.

Positive boundaries checked: uppercase/lowercase and HTML/JS fallback controls in S02 preserve CSS credit; S22 has its own New/Save fixtures and separates restart readback from post-restart writes; S23 separates stale server refusal from dirty-editor recovery; S10-S13 separate message, line, rollback and recovery; mobile operability/clipping is assigned to Polish and desktop/composition to Visual. Plausible conforming alternatives such as proactive stale-Save prevention, static previews after Stop, standard editor escape keys, native/composite controls, and intentional mobile pane scrolling are explicitly accepted. No incompatible product demand was established. Sharing observations or requiring intrinsically relevant positive controls is not itself a finding. Findings A/B concern avoidable prerequisite coupling to separately scored behaviors. Runtime scores, Oracle/target outcomes and full judge timing remain unmeasured and are not inferred from this source review.
counterexample: False-fail A: an otherwise working app rejects every nonempty title with edge whitespace, but ordinary unpadded create/update/load/revision operations work; exact and padded collisions and empty/whitespace titles are safely refused, with useful messages and unchanged records. Only padding acceptance/trimming is defective. S24 never creates its mandated Source identity, so the independent update-collision and empty-title rows lack their mandatory controls and recovery record. False-fail B: an app erroneously removes completed-preview handlers at five seconds, but before that deadline its actual Stop correctly cancels working handlers, reports Stop, and allows a new Run. S03 waits six seconds before every pre-Stop handler observation, so it cannot establish completed-Stop credit independently of the delayed-interaction failure. These are concrete source-level partial-implementation witnesses, not executed browser/model runs. A dead writer or never-working handler must still fail the appropriate negative check; the proposed fallback preserves those positive controls.
suggested_fix: Add two bounded conditional setup fallbacks without changing scoring policy: in S24, if padded creation/update fails, establish Source and its current Save format through unused unpadded titles before independent collision/empty tests; in S03, if delayed handler controls fail, rerun the same valid fixture, observe an immediate working handler, then Stop promptly and check suppression/recovery. Retain the original trimming/delayed-interaction failures. Exercise both partial variants before refreezing.
